title: SourceSpec
description: Git-tracked source specification record for create-agent-harness knowledge library (schema_version 1).

kind.description: Source kind distinguishing GitHub repositories, starred subscriptions, and general web documents

url.description: Canonicalized source URL (credentials and tracking parameters stripped)

title.description: Human-readable label or title for the source

note.description: Optional human notes explaining why this source was registered

enabled.description: Active flag. Disabled sources are retained in Git history but omitted from new search snapshots

refresh_hours.description: TTL interval in hours before checking for remote modifications

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with offset of initial registration

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with offset of last metadata change
